cache_reuse.ambiguity: Reuse only if every finite repeated cached value is bit-identical.
cache_reuse.identity: SHA256 of checkpoint, revision, exact premise, exact hypothesis.
cache_reuse.source: Existing fit-only semantic-attribution NLI cache with the exact same checkpoint/revision.

label_boundary.interpretation: All pair metrics diagnose frozen-NLI sensitivity on fit-only silver; they are not factual accuracy, held-out evaluation, or a RAGTruth score.
label_boundary.supported_role: Mechanically supported by an exact source sentence/passage identity.

nli.gpu_gate: gpu-smoke and extract are separate explicit commands after CPU check.
nli.pair: Use each row's exact nli_premise as premise and each endpoint claim as hypothesis.
nli.precision: CUDA FP32; autocast and TF32 disabled

purpose: Paired sensitivity stress test of an unchanged frozen NLI checkpoint.

qualitative_qc.source: Frozen 92-row research-agent review produced before this stress test.
qualitative_qc.use: Descriptive stratification only after primary all-4109 metrics are computed.

scores.endpoint_AUROC: Across the 2N endpoints, corrupted=1 and supported=0; threshold-free and unpaired across endpoint rows.
scores.hard_pair_accuracy: Both supported argmax=entailment and corrupted argmax=contradiction.
scores.pair_accuracy: Fraction with corrupted endpoint score strictly greater than its supported endpoint; ties count as incorrect and are reported.
scores.paired_concordance: Same comparison with a tie worth 0.5.
scores.reporting: Overall and separately for entity, number, negation, temporal, attribution.
scores.risk: max(P(contradiction), 1-P(entailment)); under normalized E/N/C this equals 1-P(entailment).
